notes.title: CELESTIAL RETURN: BIG UPDATE IS LIVE!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

We’ve been quiet… but for good reason. We just dropped a [b]major update[/b] for Celestial Return, and it’s packed with changes you’ve gotta see. 

[b]WHAT’S NEW?[/b]

🔹[b]Updated Dice Mechanics[/b] – We’ve made some huge changes to the dice system, to make it way more strategic. Dice aren’t just luck anymore, they’re currency.
🔹 [b]Fresh UI [/b]– We stripped the clutter. Everything’s smoother, sharper, and way less “what-do-I-click-again?

Thanks for hanging in there while we made these upgrades!

As always, let us know what you think, we’re all ears. 

Cheers,

[b]P.S. [/b]More tweaks are coming (we’re never done). Jump in our [url=https://discord.gg/CcDnmdwngV][Discord][/url] to rant, rave, or roast us. We’ll listen.
